topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I opened the attic door, the creak a familiar sound, but what lay inside caught me off guard. The air was thick with dust and memories, not just mine, but those of the previous occupants. Boxes, old furniture, and what looked like a child’s playhouse were piled in the corners, each item a whisper of a story I hadn’t been part of. I knew we should have been more thorough, should have asked, should have made sure this space was as clean and empty as the rest. As I stood there, the weight of what I saw pressing down, I realized there was a lot more to settle before this house truly felt like home.
